core: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
name: Erythrocyte heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
rationale: Members cover heme biosynthesis, iron homeostasis and erythrocyte O2/CO2/ammonium (Rh) transport; unlike confusables built on transferrin uptake, heme scavenging or Fe-S/TCA maturation, this theme adds red-cell gas exchange and Rh transport.

name: Oligodendrocyte differentiation, CNS myelination and glial proliferation
rationale: Members concern glial (mainly oligodendrocyte) proliferation, differentiation and central myelin formation/maintenance, whereas confusables centre on peripheral Schwann-cell myelination, axon regeneration, nodal assembly or glial fate specification.

name: Viral protein maturation and assembly, coronavirus host targeting
rationale: Members are post-translational maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host PDZ/signalling proteins, while confusables are dominated by viral attachment and entry.

name: FLT3 drug-resistant mutants and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are FLT3 inhibitor-resistant mutants and FLT3/CBL regulation plus EPO, TPO and G-CSF signaling to STAT5, distinguishing it from confusables built on ALK, FGFR, PDGFR, KIT or ERBB2 oncogenic mutants.

core: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and lipid digestion
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and dietary lipid digestion
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion, lipase/phospholipid catabolism and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, whereas confusables emphasise sterol absorption transporters and lipoprotein remodeling/clearance.

qualifier: restraint of epithelial migration and spreading
name: Leading-edge protrusion regulation and epithelial migration restraint
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, pseudopodia, actin polymerization and leading-edge localization while negatively regulating ruffles, spreading and epithelial migration, which the actin-severing/contraction confusables lack.

name: Mammary epithelial lineage differentiation, alveologenesis and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary epithelial lineages (stem, luminal, myoepithelial, alveolar), alveolar development and lactation, distinct from confusables on ductal branching, involution or prostate/reproductive tract development.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor ligand binding/neutrophil response and granulocyte chemotaxis, unlike confusables on extravasation, degranulation or generic myeloid activation.

name: Ectodermal appendage development including hair, teeth and melanocytes
rationale: Members are ectoderm/placode-derived organogenesis (hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland, taste papilla, melanocytes), distinguishing it from keratinocyte cornification and barrier confusables.

name: HIV early replication from entry to proviral integration
rationale: Members span HIV binding, uncoating, reverse transcription, PIC nuclear import, integration and 2-LTR/autointegration circles, unlike confusables on viral latency/transcription, influenza RNA synthesis or APOBEC editing.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and activity-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle responses to activity and inactivity, atrophy, growth and homeostasis, whereas confusables centre on myoblast differentiation, regeneration or cardiac muscle adaptation.

core: Myeloid and dendritic cell inflammatory activation
name: NF-kB-driven myeloid and dendritic cell inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members are myeloid/dendritic-cell NF-kB activation and TNF/IL-23-type inflammatory cytokine modules, distinct from T-cell regulation, chemokine-driven migration, anti-inflammatory regulation or IL-15/NK confusables.

core: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
qualifier: anti-inflammatory, IL-37 and IL-10 production control
name: Anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-12 family and IL-37 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signaling plus regulation of IL-10 production, distinguishing it from confusables on Th2/mast-cell cytokines, IL-15/interferon-lambda or IL-17/fungal responses.

name: Repair DNA synthesis in recombinational double-strand break repair
rationale: Members concern DNA synthesis-dependent DSB repair (break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange) and polymerase/unwinding activity, unlike confusables on DSB sensing, NHEJ or cell-cycle checkpoints.

qualifier: Cajal body snoRNP and telomerase assembly
name: rRNA/tRNA modification and Cajal body snoRNP-telomerase assembly
rationale: Members are methylation and pseudouridylation of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA plus snoRNP/scaRNA and telomerase assembly at Cajal bodies, distinct from rRNA cleavage/transcription, RNA decay and mitochondrial translation confusables.

qualifier: chain-type editing, deubiquitinases, neddylation, proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain editing, deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover linkage-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/COP9 deneddylation and proteasome assembly, whereas confusables emphasise substrate degradation, antigen processing or protein quality control and autophagy.

core: Receptor signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: Erythropoietin/thrombopoietin, CSF1 and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are EPO, TPO, CSF1, interleukin-SHC and ALK/LTK signaling converging on PI3K-AKT, RAS-ERK and STAT5, distinct from MET, IGF1R/IRS and oncogenic FGFR/PDGFR fusion confusables.

qualifier: MyD88/TRIF control of inflammatory cytokine induction
name: Regulation of Toll-like receptor signaling and inflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signaling and induction of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF, unlike confusables on adaptor-kinase mechanics, cytokine suppression or inflammasomes.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply, N- and O-glycan processing
name: Nucleotide-sugar metabolism and protein and lipid glycosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialylation, fucosylation, blood-group and glycosphingolipid synthesis and their CDG defects, beyond the GPI-anchor and lysosomal glycolipid catabolism confusables.

name: ATP-sensitive potassium channels and ischemic/metabolic stress response
rationale: Members are KATP channels (ABCC8/ABCC9 defects) and responses to ischemia, hydrogen sulfide and oxygen metabolism, distinct from two-pore/calcium-activated K+ channels, purinergic signaling or redox confusables.

name: Endocannabinoid metabolism and acylglycerol/lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover DAG/MAG catabolism, NAPE/NAE metabolism, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and retrograde endocannabinoid signaling, unlike confusables on phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling, glycerolipid synthesis or lipid transfer.

name: SGLT/GLUT-mediated intestinal and renal hexose transport
rationale: All members concern glucose/galactose transport by SLC5A1/SLC5A2/SLC2A2 and their absorption/reabsorption disorders, distinct from galactose metabolism, fructose/urate or anion transporter confusables.

name: Regulation of TRAIL/TNF death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate death-domain receptor apoptosis (TRAIL, TNF), execution phase, necrosis and hepatocyte apoptosis, distinct from Fas/T-cell death, TNFR1-NF-kB and caspase-8/necroptosis machinery confusables.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis of lung, mammary and prostate
rationale: Members are mesenchymal-epithelial signaling driving bud formation and branching in lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands, distinct from kidney, pancreatic and female reproductive tract confusables.

name: Primitive and definitive erythropoiesis with terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members concern primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and late erythroid membrane remodeling/enucleation, distinct from HSC homeostasis, myeloid progenitor and heme metabolism confusables.
